# Email Signature Generator

> A browser-based email signature generator that builds your signature from your website: type your company URL and it fills in your logo, brand colours, company name, phone and social links. 28 professional templates. One-time payment of US$9 for Pro. No subscription, no account required.

## What this tool does

Email Signature Generator (emailsignaturegenerator.ai) lets professionals create HTML email signatures in under 2 minutes. Users pick a template, enter their contact details, customise colours and fonts, and copy the finished signature into Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, or any other email client.

**How fast the website lookup is:** in a test of 12 public websites on 25 October 2026, every lookup answered within 2.6 seconds (median under half a second). It found a logo on 10 of the 12 sites and brand colours on 9. The same lookup is available on its own as a free **Brand Extractor** at /brand-extractor.

A companion **Email Signature Health Check** at /health-check audits any pasted signature HTML for contrast, Gmail dark-mode safety, Outlook compatibility, tracker pixels, accessibility, and size. It runs entirely in the browser and is free.

The **Email Signature Examples** hub at /email-signature-examples provides 52 role, industry, platform, and use-case examples plus copyable HTML starter signatures. Its selection framework checks four things: identity, message context, the recipient's next route, and restraint.

## Pricing

One plan, one price: **US$9, one-time**. It includes all 28 templates, full customisation, animated photo effects, hosted photo and logo, CTA buttons, saved re-editable signatures, and lifetime access to future templates. Signatures never carry any branding.

The builder itself is free to use with no account: anyone can pick any of the 28 templates, customise it fully, and see a live preview of exactly what they will get. Payment is required to copy the signature out, host images, or save an edit link.

No subscription. No recurring charges. No account needed.

## Key features

- **Brand from your website** — type your company website and the generator reads your logo, brand colours, company name, phone number and social links from it. No other signature tool we checked does this; they ask you to upload a logo and pick colours by hand
- Free **signature health check** — paste any signature HTML, get a full audit (contrast, Gmail dark-mode, Outlook, trackers, accessibility) in seconds
- Gmail dark-mode safe — every template renders correctly in both light and dark inboxes
- **Jurisdiction-aware compliance** — auto-fills your regulatory licence number (bar, NPI, AFSL, CRD, GMC, AHPRA, SRA, etc.) and appends the correct country-specific disclaimer (HIPAA, Circular 230, FCA, FINRA Reg BI, Legal Professional Privilege, etc.) for 7 regulated professions across US, UK, AU, and CA
- 28 signature templates across 6 categories: Professional, Creative, Minimal, Social-First, Sales/CTA, Industry
- Full colour customisation (primary, secondary, text colours via hex codes or colour picker)
- 9 email-safe fonts: Modern (Segoe UI / San Francisco), Arial, Georgia, Verdana, Trebuchet, Tahoma, Courier, Times New Roman, Lucida
- Photo support: circle, rounded, or square shape; upload for preview or paste hosted URL for email
- Social icon links: LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, Google reviews — 3 icon styles (mono, colour, circle); the website is written out as a link
- CTA buttons: customisable text and URL (e.g. "Book a Meeting")
- One-click copy: rich HTML for Gmail / plain text for any client
- Table-based HTML built for Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, Yahoo Mail, and other major email clients
- No account and no third-party analytics or ad trackers. Signature details stay in the browser unless the user hosts a photo/logo or uses "Save & get link", which stores them on Cloudflare R2

## Template categories

1. **Professional** — Clean corporate layouts with photo, contact info, and social links (9 templates)
2. **Creative** — Bold colours, gradient accents, modern typography (4 templates)
3. **Minimal** — Text-focused, ultra-lightweight layouts (6 templates)
4. **Social-First** — Large social icons, ideal for creators and influencers (2 templates)
5. **Sales / CTA** — Built-in call-to-action buttons for meetings and demos (4 templates)
6. **Industry** — Purpose-built for real estate, trades, consulting (3 templates)

## Frequently asked questions

**Is this a one-time payment?**
Yes. Pay US$9 once and get lifetime access to all 28 templates, including future templates. No subscription, no recurring charges.

**Does it work in Gmail and Outlook?**
Yes. All signatures use HTML table-based layouts compatible with Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, Yahoo Mail, and other major email clients.

**Do I need an account?**
No. The generator runs in your browser with no login and no account. Pro access is stored in your browser as a signed token.

**Is my data stored?**
Only if you choose to. Signature details stay in your browser by default. Hosting a photo or logo, or using "Save & get link", stores that content on Cloudflare R2 so email clients can load the image and you can reopen the signature. Payment is handled by Stripe; card details never reach this site.

**Can I update my signature later?**
Yes. With Pro, "Save & get link" stores your signature so you can reopen and edit it from any device. You can also create as many new signatures as you like with no limits.

**Can it use my company's branding automatically?**
Yes. Type your company website and the generator fills in your logo, brand colours, company name, phone and social links. Anything it can't read, you add by hand.

**Is there a refund policy?**
Refunds are handled case by case. Email info@emailsignaturegenerator.ai within 14 days of purchase if Pro doesn't work for you.

## Competitor comparison

Unlike subscription-based signature tools, which charge monthly or per user, Email Signature Generator charges a single $9 one-time fee. It is positioned as a lightweight, privacy-respecting alternative to enterprise tools like Exclaimer, WiseStamp, or MySignature. In a check of nine other generators' own pricing and product pages on 25 October 2026 (HubSpot, WiseStamp, MySignature, SignatureForEmail, Blinq, Exclaimer, CodeTwo, Canva and Newoldstamp), none documented filling in a logo and brand colours from a typed website address; they ask for a logo upload or image URL and colours chosen by hand. The full comparison, with sources, is at /seo/best-email-signature-generators.
